name: Adil Ahmad Dar
portrayed_by: Fictionalized or real; suicide bomber archetype
real_life_parallel: Pulwama suicide bomber; 22-year-old Kashmiri; killed 40 CRPF

biography.background: 22-year-old Kashmiri who carried out suicide bombing of CRPF convoy on Jammu-Srinagar highway February 14, 2019. R explosives-laden SUV into bus; 40 personnel killed. JeM claimed responsibility.
biography.profile: Former mason; joined militancy 2018; video before attack showed weapons; 'taking revenge for oppression'
biography.impact: Deadliest attack on Indian forces in Kashmir in decades; triggered Balakot response
biography.film_relevance: Part 3: Pulwama attack; Balakot catalyst; martyrdom video
